name: Documentation workbench
approval: Supporting composition. Carry forward its install command and Task Flow workbench depth.
prompt: Create a high-fidelity 1536 by 1024 desktop documentation homepage for the Uai shadcn registry. Use Beautiful UI as the binding visual-language reference and shadcn as the information-architecture reference. Build a narrow left rail and an asymmetric main area with the headline Open code for AI products, a shadcn install command, and one dominant live Task Flow stage containing thinking, tool, approval, and composer states. Continue into a readable documentation article. Use near-black graphite surfaces, thin low-contrast borders, compact sans typography, mono metadata, and restrained cobalt state accents. Avoid gradients, glow, glass, giant empty heroes, bento grids, generic dashboards, photography, 3D, and watermarks.
